caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing figure on a square wooden pedestal. The figure is shown with dark brown skin and is adorned in a knee-length skirt and tunic featuring a pattern resembling large leaves or feathers, predominantly in shades of brown with some white and pale pink accents. The tunic has short, loose sleeves and a rounded neck, and the skirt overlay has feather or leaf details hanging down. The figure wears moccasin-style shoes and has a prominent belt or sash around the waist tied at the front, with the ends hanging down. On the figure’s head is a headdress with three upright white feathers. The right hand is extended outward with the palm up, and the left hand is bent at the side, holding a bundle of what appears to be cigars or rolled objects. The statue and pedestal are rendered with realistic texture and shading, and the background is plain and light in color.
title: Cigar Store Indian
